items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: Bobby Watson, another alto saxophonist... These are the youngsters that are, that are carrying on authentic jazz.

ctx.x: Could you name a couple of those groups?

Young groups, you know like Terrance Blanchard, of course the Elvin Jones group makes use of a lot of youngsters such as Nicholas Payton and they even use Coltrane’s son, Ravi Coltrane with Elvin Jones. And of course Vincent Herring, an alto saxophonist, Jesse Davis, another alto saxophonist, Bobby Watson, another alto saxophonist, Roy Hargrove, Chris McBride, Antonio Hart. These are the youngsters that are, that are carrying on authentic jazz. This is not the Basie style, now, I’m talking about small group jazz.…
No, not necessarily doing the Basie thing, but in other words, just putting your thumb on the pulse and saying, are the traditions alive and well?
